description: MCP server that sends mail over SMTP, gated behind an allowlist and a human confirmation
name: io.github.ni-c/smtp-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Hostname of the SMTP server, e.g. smtp.example.net.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Port. Defaults to 587 for starttls, 465 for implicit, 25 for none.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: starttls (default), implicit or none. STARTTLS is required, never opportunistic.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_TLS

environmentVariables.description: Password or app-specific password for SMTP authentication.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: The only sender this server will use, e.g. "Name <person@example.net>". There is no from parameter.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_FROM

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to register the sending tools. Defaults to false: the server cannot send until it is set.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ALLOW_SEND

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated addresses and @domains this server may write to. Required with SMTP_ALLOW_SEND=true; "*" allows any.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum distinct recipients across To, Cc and Bcc in one message. Default 10.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Sliding hourly cap on messages sent. Default 20.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_HOUR

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of the composed message. Default 10485760.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of a single attachment. Default 5242880.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Directory attachments are read from. Unset means attachments are unavailable.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ATTACHMENT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated content types that may be attached. Defaults to a document and image allowlist.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ATTACHMENT_TYPES

environmentVariables.description: Text appended below the standard signature delimiter of every message.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_SIGNATURE

environmentVariables.description: File the audit lines are appended to, in addition to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_AUDIT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names, a prefix with one trailing *, or "essential" for the curated preset.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or prefixes to remove, applied after SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_DENY_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to accept self-signed certificates. Prefer a proper internal CA.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_INSECURE_TLS

title: SMTP
